answer: Each epoch, peers swap signed attestations through a rotating willow relay, so forging many identities means posting many bonds and maintaining distinct relay histories. Agents stake a violet bond that is slashed if a whisper of duplicate identity surfaces. A sock-puppet farm must pay N times the stake plus sustained bandwidth to fake independent attestations, while honest agents risk only one bond. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, making large-scale capture economically irrational. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
